Hi Samir / Dana,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation with security and infra. Per our call, attached is a compact pricing matrix with the bundles we discussed. High-level options below (attached: bluehaven_pricing_matrix.xlsx, SOC2-excerpt.pdf):

- Audit logs: retention tiers of 30 / 365 / 730 days; ingestion metered per 1M events after free pilot allocation.
- KMS/HSM: two patterns — (A) Managed KMS (per 1M keys + usage) or (B) Dedicated HSM seats (good for strict FIPS requirements). HSM seats include a baseline throughput cap; we can size for peak with an optional throughput add-on.
- Data residency: pilot can run in US-only (single-region) with staged EU rollout in month 3.
- HIPAA pilot concession: 25% on hosted inference unit price for first 6 months OR a $60k implementation credit that we can amortize.

Questions for you to confirm so we can produce a final quote:
1) Do you prefer an HSM seat or managed KMS for the pilot?
2) Which audit-log retention tier do you expect to use during pilot vs scale?
3) Would you like the implementation credit amortized across invoices or applied as a one-time SOW credit?

If you like, we can do a short call with Marcus (sales) and Aditya (infra) to nail sizing.

Best,

Samir — thanks for the questions. Squared up answers / proposals below; I kept them short so you can share with procurement/security.

1) HSM sizing & throughput
- Typical HSM "seat" includes 2 HSM instances behind a HA pair; baseline throughput: ~250 TPS for crypto ops, burst to 1k TPS with the throughput add-on. For most EHR-integrated workloads we recommend the seat + throughput add-on if you anticipate heavy bulk signing.

2) Audit log handling during pilot
- Pilot allocation includes 10M events/mo free. Anything above that is billed at $4 per 1M events. For your estimated 12M/mo during pilot, that would be one overage bucket (~$8/mo).

3) Implementation credit amortization
- We can offer two options: A) $60k implementation credit applied as a one-time SOW credit, or B) $45k credit amortized over the first 6 monthly invoices (i.e., $7.5k/month). Option B is our recommended approach if you want flatter monthly OPEX.

4) SOC2 evidence
- We can share the full SOC2 report under an NDA / SecureShare link. The attached PDF is an excerpt for initial review.

Proposed packaging (short):
- Pilot Package (recommended): 6-month pilot, US residency, managed KMS or 1 HSM seat (your choice), 25% pilot discount on inference + $45k amortized credit (if you pick amortization).
- Committed Package: 12-36 month reserved capacity, HSM seats sized to peak, deeper commit discount and included auditlog retention at 365 days.

Attached updated pricing matrix with the amortization example and HSM throughput numbers. LMK if you want a quick joint call next week and I’ll send a calendar invite.

—Marcus
